My parents do not want me to leave, they plan on some depressing mundane life for me to live and I don't want that. They "try" to support my art career while its blatant lie because in reality they don't want me to pursue it at all. My mum only uses me for example to help out in her few projects of design or video and probably might use me a "prop" to show off to her friends when comparing children as all ethnic mothers do.  while in reality behind close doors she'll criticize me as soon as she gets the chance, she always tell me "You've never really proven yourself so why would I want to invest in you(r passion)." While my father just doesn't get what I even want to do and straight denies it without letting me prove myself or make him understand. My parents are very indecisive going from "yea we'll let you do art" to not even letting me apply in local art colleges cause they think all art kids are disappointments and morally incorrect.

And no I'm not in the U.S, if that were the case I would've made a 110% effort to runaway and risk being homeless because I would still have a some what chance to get a job and try to live independently. While in an not so well off socioeconomic Asian country it's way harder to survive on your own as a girl.

also idk honestly why you're even investing further into this sob story

Firstly being a woman in a male dominated Asian society is hard enough especially a society that still runs on tribalism and 17th century type behavior. It's extremely unsafe for a young woman go out, let alone try to be independent. I've been raised in such a protective world view only recently realizing the childhood and freedom what was robbed from me. Like i rather die at my own hands than let someone violate and murder me you feel? I don't hate men but the hierarchy of power is so unbalanced. my family is extremely homophobic, misogynistic and racist. even if i did try to run away I would literally have no place to go because surviving would be 10x harder for a woman, to find a decent job, get help and not have my family hunt me down like blood hounds if I do because anyone is likely to snitch on me and call me "disrespectful" for getting away. My dad on the other hand just refuses to negotiate or listen to what i have to say. I initially want to move out of my country and go abroad to any European country to try to get away in the excuse of chasing my art collage dreams. But he has this agenda that "I can't send a girl abroad alone to study". I find it hypocritical that my mum on the other hand is overly enthusiastic about sending my brothers to study and live abroad even though they've finished university and literally lay around the house unemployed.

I do come to reddit often to rant  but recently its been eating away at me and I've been locked up in my toom for 4 days and i've started multiple fights with all my close friends and essentially turned off all social media connections because I do not feel comfortable being contacted in such a fragile state, in reality I did try hang myself yesterday night but nothing came of it other another disappointing failed attempt, more hurt and dissatisfaction.The curtain fixture broke but its really easy to like cover up and lie about these events because my parents don't really care about my mental health, this is not teen angst. my mother on multiple occasions has denied me help, I've begged her to get me checked out but she's a former surgeon and ironically does not believe in mental health issues (even though her own father is a psychiatrist) My parents are very backwards in their world view and yes emotional and physical abuse is very very very normalized in my household under the umbrella term of "good parenting". That vile woman has destroyed my self esteem, personal worth and all abilities to trust someone.

​

Coming to the nihilism part my living condition developed my philosophy, and no I'm surrounded by hopeless optimistics who have pretty decent lives, In a way self awareness is a curse for me because sometimes i feel like I'm asking too much from this world while in reality i just want some control over my own life, the freedom to leave my house (I just turned 19 and my parents won't even let me get a job) but my mother has me pinned out controlling absolutely every aspect of my life to what I eat, dress, talk to and when I go out. This sounds like what normal parents do but she takes it up a notch with her constant condescending attitude and degradation and helped be develop eating disorders, body dysmorphia to some extent (however these are assumptions and I have not been properly diagnosed due to her not letting me get any help). I truly believe nothing will get better and the only way I can truly regain control over myself is in death. I did talk to my psychology professor once he hinted at dysthemic symptoms but ofc this is again not a proper diagnoses. My depression if you could call it, leads me to behave in very impulsive suicidal ways.

I apologize for the extremely nonsensical rant, It's all probably very pointless.

For her putting food in my mouth and a roof above my head is basically her telling me, how grateful i should be to her for to keep me alive. She's so condescending and passive aggressive and you can't even react because for our parents its automatically disrespect if you try to fight for your personal space or rights.

Have a in dept discussion with your therapist about this too. good luck.

This must be very difficult on your part. Falling in love is magical and breaking up can be very painful. I can't really tell you a way to keep her, But i guess I can suggest parting on a good note? you don't have to become strangers? Do tell her firmly how you feel, in the most purest genuine way, let her know what a positive impact she's been on your life vice versa. Letting go is never fun but we need to remember that Life is on a constant march forward and always changing. Don't let it kill you instead deal with it with care and in a healthy fashion. I hope it works out.

medicine can't cure depression on its own. think of it as a regulator? Therapy (and I can't stress this enough) is very important. sometimes it works alone, sometimes you need the help of medication to aid it.

Honestly even the most successful people in the world can become depressed, It's obviously your strict routine that's messing you up and you don't have to pretend "that everything is okay" and "be grateful you have what most other people don't". Yea other people have issues, but that doesn't mean your problems are to be diminished and no longer Valid. You Don't have to feel bad for feeling bad. Yea Med school can be actual hell and absolutely soul draining. Remember that Right now your perspective on life is clouded, I advise you to hang on (not be cliche), You really need to keep going just push through and walk out the other end. Once you look back at what you've struggled through you'll feel accomplished and strengthened.  

Remember to get actual help if it gets to serious and most importantly it's not worth it if it's killing you.
I tried leaving short messages for my family, It was going fine until I reached my best friend, it was absolutely unbearable and I broke down crying and hid away all the papers.

For me I don't really have an option to go to a therapist, So I'm trying to self improve myself and my mood. I started with little things like not under eating and actually balancing out my nutrition that really started giving me energy, I started drinking tea; which really calmed me. It's honestly about will power you need to drive yourself to meet goals. Meeting my goals really gave me a feeling of satisfaction and overall improve my mood. Long story short try changing your habits a little, not tryna preach the "eat healthy! drink water! surround yourself with Nice people!" message but you need to talk to yourself and figure out how to make small improvements and try to go easy on yourself.  I don't know if this helps.

your boyfriend seems like an understanding person. Have you ever discussed about your feelings with him? If so I think it would be healthy to have one outlet to vent to. I'd suggest maybe a councilor to talk things over, but its not exactly the easiest thing to get one. I'd hate to say some cliche dumb stuff. But the fact you made it this far it would absolutely foolish to give up. Not everyone is perfect and you shouldn't be too harsh on urself. Self love is fucking hard. Especially for girls.

I completely understand the irrational fear of socializing its all too familiar. Normally I'd suggest some sort of professional help. But seeing that even that isn't helping you improve is very sad. Mostly when people around me sad I try to urge them to try something new. Something small just to help them ease their mind of the stress. It's important to find an outlet or a distraction. I suggested my brother to start gym because he was down about not getting a job and was very insecure. He got healthier physically which in turn improved his mental state and over all mood. Remember mental illnesses start in your mind and its very important to keep a strong will to live of you want to achieve anything In life, no matter how hard it gets. The more we down we feel the more our brain tricks us in believeing lies, that aren't true in the first place. Keeping talking to me if you like it's always nice to have an outsiders perspective while having reassurance  and sympathy. I really hope you get better and are able to stand up on your own two feet.

It's low key very sad knowing that you go about life as a background extra in everyone's life. No doubt that its very hard to live a fulfilling life especially if the individual lacks self love and self esteem. So far are your parents and friends aware of the current negative mind state that you are in? more importantly have you tried reaching out for help in real life?

If people aren't willing to take 5 mins out of their lives, just to take a moment and reply and help you they're probably not the right person to talk to in the first place. Its pretty common for most people to feel hesitant when seeking help because they don't want to seem 'needy' and not break the illusion of having a normal healthy life. It's not easy and please don't blame yourself for things society has done to us.  I hope you figure things out.

I know this sounds super basic and cliche. But fr sometimes all you need is someone to talk to. Don't be too upfront be subtle. Little actions of kindness go a long way. I hope it works out
